description: This line plot compares the training and validation loss for two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, across 600,000 training steps during the Embedding and LM Head training stage. The x-axis represents the training step, ranging from 0 to 600,000 on a linear scale, labeled “Step”. The y-axis represents the loss value, ranging from approximately 2×10⁰ to 1.2×10¹ on a logarithmic scale, labeled “Loss”. The solid blue line with circular markers, labeled “Ex1 Loss”, starts at approximately 1.1×10¹ and decreases sharply to stabilize near 2×10⁰ by step 20,000. The solid cyan line with circular markers, labeled “Ex2 Loss”, begins at approximately 3×10⁰, decreases more gradually, and stabilizes near 2×10⁰ by step 20,000. The dashed blue line with circular markers, labeled “Ex1 Validation Loss”, starts at approximately 1.1×10¹, drops to around 3×10⁰ by step 10,000, and then plateaus near 3×10⁰. The dashed cyan line with circular markers, labeled “Ex2 Validation Loss”, begins at approximately 3×10⁰, declines slightly to around 4×10⁰ by step 10,000, and then stabilizes near 3×10⁰.
